title: Labwright: a verifiable wet-lab design copilot — LabMath-Bench test set, evaluation pipeline and one-click reproduction
description:
Labwright is a verifiable wet-lab design copilot: a deterministic calculator layer behind an LLM ReAct agent, where no number enters a design unless a calculator computed it and a verifier re-proved it. This deposit is the reproducibility bundle for the LabMath-Bench evaluation (DeepSeek flash/pro models): the gold test set (eval/gold_labmath_combined.json, 610 entries across three difficulty levels L1-L3), all evaluation scripts (eval/), the one-click reproduction driver (scripts/reproduce_all.sh), the committed benchmark result JSONs the paper's reported numbers are derived from, and the runtime requirements.

On a bare checkout (python3 only) run scripts/reproduce_all.sh: it bootstraps a clean virtualenv, regenerates the gold sets, renders the figures, rebuilds the supplementary traceability log, and runs the full test suite plus the claims audit. The live-LLM benchmark loops require a DeepSeek API key and cost tokens; the deterministic pipeline (gold generation, offline analysis, figures, tests, audit) runs entirely offline. The fine-tuned raw-input extractor (torch/peft stack, requirements-eval.txt) is optional and not required for reproduction.

See github.com/qgeng1465/labwright for the live repository; this Zenodo deposit is the immutable snapshot referenced by the paper's Data and Code Availability statement.
